thread:
maria_product: Quick sync — drafting recruitment + feedback plan for the next design partner cohort. Goal: 8-week engagement, ~12 partners, mix of hosted/dedicated/private. Need ops on capacity, CS on success criteria, legal on NDA gating. TL;DR below.

maria_product: Draft TL;DR: cohort size 12, 3 waves of 4, staggered by 2 weeks; onboarding checklist, weekly feedback call + async eval forms, biweekly quality checkpoints, and a final roll decision. Incentive: $1k credit + early roadmap influence.

devon_research: Love the waves. Ask: can we ensure representation across 3 workload buckets (low-latency chat, high-throughput generative, embedding-heavy)? sampling matters for Optimize signals.

alex_eng: Heads up on capacity — Dedicated pools need reservation lead time. For 12 partners in 3 waves we should reserve an extra 20% headroom per wave. If start is Apr 6, we need capacity requests in infra by Mar 30.

jordyn_ops: +1. Also: prefer 2-week stagger (ok). Autoscale policy: min replicas pinned for wave start, allow burst for first 48h. We should document fallback models for when capacity is low (quantized variants).

sam_cs: Success criteria suggestions: 1) active usage by 80% partners week 2; 2) <2 regressions flagged per partner per checkpoint (quality threshold); 3) NPS >= 7 for the program at exit. We also need a clear escalation path for partner blockers.

maria_product: Good list. For feedback loops — propose weekly async form (short), one focused weekly call, and an open channel for bugs. Form fields: task, prompt, expected vs observed, severity.

devon_research: Add an eval harness snippet for reproducible checks. Example:
```
# sample eval trigger
ruby run_eval.rb --prompts seed_100.json --model redwood-v1 --metrics perplexity,chrF
```
Include a tiny seed set per partner.

alex_eng: Re: fallback models, suggest we publish a compatibility matrix: primary model -> fallback variant (e.g., redwood-v1-quant -> redwood-v1-int8). Ops can auto-route based on policy. I'll sketch it.

jordyn_ops: Also need SLA language for cohort partners: best-effort vs SLA-backed for Dedicated. We'll offer SLA for Dedicated beta customers only, hosted partners get documented SLOs. Legal to confirm wording.

legal_bot: Quick note: NDAs for partners with private deployments need legal sign-off + data processing addendum. Please tag legal at least 10 business days before onboarding.

maria_product: Noted. Timeline checkpoint: planning freeze Mar 26, capacity requests due Mar 30, partner invite send Apr 1, wave1 start Apr 6. Can we compress?

alex_eng: We can compress start to Apr 4 if infra approves today; otherwise keep Apr 6.

sam_cs: CS readiness: onboarding playbook + 1:1 templates ready by Apr 1. I can run three mock onboards week of Mar 30.

devon_research: One more: telemetry minimums — token-level latency, error rate, top-10 prompt failures, sample outputs (anonymized) per partner snapshot. We need these to evaluate Optimize signals.

jordyn_ops: Agree. Ops will add a standard dashboard template and a cost-tracking tag for the cohort.

maria_product: Great. Action items: 
- maria_product: finalize partner invite + incentive copy by Mar 25
- alex_eng: draft fallback compatibility matrix + capacity estimate by Mar 28
- jordyn_ops: autoscale & dashboard config + cost tags by Mar 28
- sam_cs: onboarding playbook + mock runs by Apr 1
- devon_research: seed eval sets + harness example by Mar 28
- legal_bot: NDA/DPA checklist; confirm 10 business day lead by Mar 24

maria_product: If nobody objects, I'll lock planning freeze Mar 26 and start outreach next week. :thumbsup:

sam_cs: :thumbsup: from CS. Ready to take invites.

alex_eng: :+1: will ping infra for expedited capacity review.

devon_research: :ok_hand: will start pulling representative prompts.

jordyn_ops: :white_check_mark: will prep dashboard template.

legal_bot: Acknowledged.

maria_product: Thanks team — will post the invite draft here for quick review later today.
